fpga/deployment_contract.json.rounding: nearest, ties toward positive infinity; signed arithmetic right shift required
fpga/deployment_contract.json.weight_order: OIHW C order, signed two-complement int8; .bin one byte per weight
fpga/deployment_contract.json.bias_order: output-channel vector, signed little-endian int32; .hex one 32-bit word per line
fpga/deployment_contract.json.activation_order: all golden intermediate maps HWC UINT8; final RGB files explicitly HWC or CHW
fpga/deployment_contract.json.padding: zero at first low-res 3x3 conv; last two convs are1x1
fpga/deployment_contract.json.normalization: two training BatchNorm layers folded into conv before QAT
fpga/deployment_contract.json.temporal: stateless deterministic inference, fixed scales; no per-frame statistics or random texture
fpga/deployment_contract.json.onnx_note: fp32 graph is standard floating point; integer_reference.onnx uses FLOAT32-valued INTEGER arithmetic as a golden, not QLinearConv, compiled hardware or a BIT
fpga/deployment_contract.json.hardware_compatibility: different from prior C4, PixelPoster and TinyInk graphs; grayscale1/8/8/3, pool4, UINT8, zero padding and per-layer shifts require accelerator/loader configuration changes
